p: brethren and the army of Samaria: Of his companions who dwelt in Samaria.
feeble Jews: Thus the wicked who do not consider that God's power is always ready to defend his, mock them as thought they were weak and feeble.
Hear: This is the remedy that the children of God have against the derision and threatenings of their enemies, to flee to God by prayer.
in the land of captivity: Let them be spoiled and led away captive.
iniquity: Let the plagues declare to the world that they set themselves against you and your Church: that he prays only having respect for God's glory and not for any private affection, or grudge.
From all places whence ye shall: They who brought the tidings said this, when you leave your work, and go either to eat or to rest, your enemies will assail you.

remember the Lord: Who is always on hand to deliver his out of danger: and therefore seeing they should fight for the maintenance of God's glory, and for the preservation of their own lives and of theirs, he encourages them to play the valiant men.
behind all the house of Judah: To overcome them and encourage them in their work.
resort ye thither unto us: Meaning, to resist their enemies, if need be.
for washing: That is, when they purified themselves or else when they washed their clothes.
